name: In-Flight Plain Saltine Crackers (Airline Snack Pack)
whyItWorks: Simple baking soda crackers made with enriched white flour and salt. Absorbs excess gastric juices, settles flight turbulence nausea, and provides quick, harmless glucose without roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Request an extra pack of saltine crackers from the galley attendant if you feel stomach churn or hunger between meal services.
